title: Ideaspace Thread Agreement frontmatter
description: Optional frontmatter on _threads/<thread>/_agent/agreement.md only. Validate the parsed YAML object against this schema, not the ordinary Note frontmatter schema. A plain Markdown Agreement has no declared parent; malformed YAML is invalid before schema validation. Other Agreement fields remain extensible. PROVISIONAL, v0.28.0.

attached_to.description: Legacy optional parent post link. The opening post wins. A malformed Agreement attached_to is ignored with a warning, not grounds to reject the parent. No pin is carried here; see threads.md for resolution.

x-status: provisional and public — expect breaking changes before 1.0
